UPO-06: PrhI Gene Synthesis

UPO-06 holds the coding sequence for prhI from Ralstonia solanacearum. PrhI is an ECF sigma factor, and without it, transcription driven by the Prh signal transduction system doesn't happen. PrhR switches the gene on, and the gene then pushes sigma factor expression by activating the PprhJ promoter. We optimized the sequence for expression in Escherichia coli.

UPO-11: PprhJ Promoter Synthesis

UPO-11 gives you the PprhJ promoter region. When a plant cell makes contact, PrhA and PrhR pass the signal along, and the promoter responds. PrhI, the ECF sigma factor, activates it. The sequence is optimized for expression in Escherichia coli.

The alitrunk (Fig. 15) is conspicuously swollen. It sits well above the propodeal dorsum. The propodeum carries a pair of strong spines, straight to slightly upcurved. There is no metanotal groove. The metapleural lobes are triangular and easy to see.

In profile, the petiole has an elongate peduncle and a well-developed node. The node's dorsum slopes down toward the rear, so the posterior face is short. On the postpetiole, the anterior and dorsal surfaces form one convexity, and the posterior face is truncated. From above, the nodes of the petiole and postpetiole are broader than long.

The dorsum of the head is strongly longitudinally rugose, with 5–7 rugae between the frontal carinae at eye level. They are irregular and meander a little, and a few anastomoses are usually present. The scrobal area is largely smooth, but you'll typically see 1–2 fine rugulae crossing its width just behind the antennal fossa. Behind the eyes, the sides of the head are finely reticulate-rugose, and that sculpture runs around the posterior margins of the scrobe to the occiput. Every space between the rugae is unsculptured, or at most shows the faintest superficial traces.

The dorsal alitrunk is everywhere finely but strongly reticulate-rugose, with broad, shining interspaces. The petiole dorsum is rugulose. The postpetiole ranges from rugulose to only faintly sculptured. The gaster is unsculptured. Fine, acute hairs densely cover all dorsal surfaces of the head and body. Color runs from dark reddish brown to blackish brown.

Subject: Key Findings on foxl2 Expression Patterns in Trout

Here's a summary of what we found on foxl2 transcript expression in your study.

Both foxl2 transcripts turned on very early in development (Figure 2). foxl2a stayed tightly restricted in the male. Its diverged paralog, foxl2b, showed up in most adult extragonadal tissues we examined (see Additional file 2).

We derived a time-dependent mild-slope equation, following the formal derivation of Smith & Sprinks (1975). That gave us the higher-order dispersion relation for waves over uneven bottom.

Then we used only linear dispersion for steady waves, and out came equation (2.12) of Chamberlain & Porter (1995), the Modified Mild-Slope Equation (MMSE). Look at the leading-order solution: the modified curvature terms of the MMSE matter, while slope square terms stay negligible under the mild-slope assumption. So we kept every modified curvature term the MSE drops. That gave us a uniform model.

We built a numerical model with the finite element method (FEM) to predict wave scattering by a varying bottom. The uniform model predicts the main features of waves over various sea beds, sinusoidal beds and man-made bars among them. For sinusoidal beds, it agrees more closely with experimental data than other established models. For man-made bars, the MMSE and the uniform model both agree more closely with experimental data than the results of Kirby (1986).

One result of the FEM model matters a lot: it applies to wave transformation over arbitrarily-varying bathymetry.

Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) can't back up carbon neutrality claims for electricity use beyond what a claimant actually meters. Most RECs come from projects that would have been financially viable without selling them. [10] Consequently, they lack additionality. Additionality asks what would have happened under the status quo if the REC hadn't been bought or contracted. Plenty of frameworks exist for testing it, but the central question stays the same: did the project need REC revenue to survive financially? Without verified proof of additionality, RECs aren't the same as real emissions offsets.

It's about a past life, not a future one, and it stages a fight between reason backed by passion or righteous indignation and the animal instincts. In that life the soul marched in the train of some god and saw truth as the universal before birth. Our present life comes out of a struggle that happened earlier. This world is relative, and we tend to push it into the future, the way we ask where men were before birth or what comes after death. We want to share some important information about early hearing development. People usually develop spoken language within the first few years of life. Hearing impairment can prevent the ability to speak, and it can also hinder the ability to understand spoken language.

By the time it becomes clear that a severely hearing-impaired (deaf) child has a hearing deficit, communication problems may have already caused issues within the family and hindered social skills. If the child is part of a Deaf community where sign language is used instead of spoken language, these challenges can be reduced (please see our article on Deaf Culture).

In many developed countries, hearing evaluations happen during the newborn period to prevent the inadvertent isolation of a deaf child within a hearing family. Sign language is a full means of communication, but literacy ultimately depends on the ability to understand speech. In the vast majority of written language, the sound of the word is coded in symbols.

A person who hears well enough to learn to speak and read will keep the ability to read even if their hearing later becomes too impaired to hear voices. A person who never heard well enough to learn to speak is rarely able to read proficiently (see [4]). Most evidence suggests that early identification of hearing impairment is key to helping a child with very insensitive hearing learn spoken language effectively. Listening also plays an important role in learning a second language.

Transduction is how the nervous system converts physical and chemical signals into neural impulses. In sensory transduction, physical or chemical inputs are turned by specialized sensory receptors into electrical impulses that travel to the brain.

The visual system is one example. In the retina, rod and cone cells connect the physical environment to neural communication. When light strikes these photoreceptors, it triggers a change in the shape of the protein rhodopsin. That shift starts a chain of events that alters the electrochemical gradient of the photoreceptor. The drop in that gradient lowers the electrical signals sent to the brain. So more light hitting the photoreceptor means fewer electrical impulses, which lets the brain read the visual world.

It takes in a string of former industrial cities: Duisburg, Oberhausen, Bottrop, Mülheim an der Ruhr, Essen, Gelsenkirchen, Bochum, Herne, Hamm, Hagen, Dortmund, Recklinghausen, Unna, and Witten.

About five million people live here, far more than in Berlin, Hamburg, or Munich. Motorways are dense, yet hitchhiking still trips people up, because the minor roads form a tangled network. The motorways you want are the A1, A2, and A3.

Stick to those three. On the smaller roads you'll wait a long time, since almost no transit traffic passes through. Germany treats hitchhikers well on the whole, but the Ruhr Area is by far the worst part of the country for it. Hitching here feels like hitching in a big city such as Istanbul: the cities are independent, but to a traveler they come across as districts of one massive city.

We hope this helps you plan a safe and enjoyable trip.

Best regards,

[Your Name/Company]

Subject: Study Results: Lung Tissue Volume and Aeration Analysis

Dear Customer,

Here's what we found in our analysis of lung tissue volume and functional changes.

We got the total volume of lung tissue from this formula: volume of lung tissue = number of voxels × volume of the voxel, as long as the compartment has a CT number above zero.

We took the change in functional residual capacity from PEEP withdrawal (ΔFRC) as the difference in total gas volume in the whole lung between PEEP and ZEEP. Alveolar derecruitment was the difference in gas volume within poorly aerated and nonaerated lung regions between the same conditions.

We also worked out the changes in gas volume from PEEP withdrawal in normally aerated lung regions, which had CT attenuations between -500 and -900 HU (see Figure 2).

Following reference [21], we classified the distribution of lost lung aeration for each patient (lung morphology) as diffuse, patchy, or lobar, based on the distribution of CT attenuations at ZEEP.

Let's discuss these results when you have time.

Best regards,

[Your Name/Team]

Mobile internet is expanding what storytelling can do by adding electronic games that use portable, location-aware interfaces. This is the latest step in a decades-long evolution of electronic games that aim to make the player an avatar in a gameworld and a co-author alongside the original designers.

Location-aware interfaces let players make places in the physical world part of their gameworld, and the other way around. That's a first for interactive media. Mobile games also move away from linear narratives toward cooperative storytelling that depends on the player's experience of place.

The author-player worldmaking idea isn't new, but mobile games push it past the constraints of traditional video games. By extending worldmaking off the screen and into the physical world, location-aware interfaces use the player's sensory experience of real places as storytelling tools.

In our essay, we theorize what makes mobile game storytelling unique, and we describe our experience trying to use that potential in the design and implementation of our hybrid-reality game, University of Death.
